channel.title: Sound baths in Colorado Springs · Sound Bath Calendar
channel.description: A weekly-updated calendar of sound baths in Colorado Springs, Colorado: dates, times, venues, prices, and ticket links for every listed session. Part of the Front Range sound bath calendar.

item.title: Community Sound Bath Session
item.description: A free recurring session blending nervous-system education with guided sound therapy, held at Ivywild School in Colorado Springs, part of Think Positive Club's Nervous System Reset Program. Time is an estimate from a recurring '2nd & 4th Monday' pattern; exact clock time unverified. Where: Ivywild School, Colorado Springs. Price: Free. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/community-sound-bath-session-2026-08-10-ivywild-school/
